name: agent-crm-marketplace
description: The framework's own plugin marketplace. Self-hosted from this repository, which is all `/plugin marketplace add <owner>/<repo>` requires — no third party has to accept anything for this route to work.

plugins.name: agent-crm
plugins.description: Build a CRM as code you own. Eleven skills that take a coding agent from a business objective to checked-in modules, deterministic workflows, policy-gated approvals, audit and trace — plus the project MCP server, whose code-generating tools are dry-run until you pass --apply.
